metadata.description: Safe, opinionated AI Google Ads operator for technical founders running Search + Performance Max

plugins.name: google-ads-copilot
plugins.description: 12 slash commands (bootstrap, daily, weekly, monthly, search-terms, budgets, creative, recommendations, explain, changes, undo, apply) backed by a senior-Google-Ads-operator agent (Opus) and 10 skills (gaql, account-audit, conversion-health, smart-bidding, pmax, search-term-mining, budget-management, creative-management, change-execution, explain-to-beginner). 36 documented mutation kinds covering Search and Performance Max: shared negative-keyword lists, PMax asset-group asset CRUD + theme split, final-URL exclusions, brand-list management, plus the existing kinds for negatives/budgets/creative/keywords/bids/extensions/Customer Match/recommendations. Mutation safety enforced by deterministic shell scripts (bin/apply + bin/validate-proposal + bin/validate-workspace), not by the LLM: account-ID pin, schema validation, validate_only dry-run, append-only change-log, paired-proposal resource-name auto-substitution, and an explicit_yes second-factor gate (retype the proposal_id) for high-blast kinds like negative-list-delete and asset-group-create.
